content.text: Digital creators in places like Nigeria and Kenya face significant barriers when it comes to selling [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-how-sell-ebooks-kenya-complete-infrastructure-guide|ebooks]] and digital products. Conventional platforms like PayPal and Stripe are often unavailable, leaving creators with limited options. A crypto [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/why-payment-gateways-cameroon-digital-products-costing-you|Why Payment]] gateway offers a formidable solution, allowing for secure transactions without the heavy fees associated with traditional platforms. [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/understanding-solana-payments-digital-products-plain-language-infrastructure|COREMERCH guide to understanding]] how these systems work is crucial for anyone looking to sell digital products efficiently and retain more of their earnings.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-explained-digital-creators. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.
content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Crypto payment

A crypto payment gateway facilitates transactions by allowing creators to accept cryptocurrencies in exchange for digital products. Unlike traditional payment processors, which often charge high transaction fees, platforms like NOWPayments charge only 0.5%. This is especially important for creators selling multiple products; the savings can add up significantly. For instance, if you're selling a product priced at $97 and making 100 sales a month, the fee difference compared to Gumroad, which charges 10%, can result in retaining an extra $921 monthly. This infrastructure provides financial freedom and more competitive pricing for creators.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of a crypto payment gateway involves several components working together seamlessly. At the core is the payment processor, which verifies transactions on the blockchain. When a customer purchases a digital product, the payment processor handles the crypto payment, ensuring it is confirmed on-chain. This is combined with automated delivery systems, like Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, to ensure the product reaches the buyer instantly after payment confirmation. This infrastructure not only streamlines the payment process but also enhances the overall customer experience.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is designed specifically for digital creators in regions facing limitations with conventional payment processors. Whether you're selling ebooks, online courses, or design templates, this infrastructure empowers you to operate independently. By leveraging a crypto payment gateway, creators can maintain full control over their transactions and product delivery without relying on third-party platforms. This offers an effective way to monetize their work, and it’s built for those who understand the value of ownership and sovereignty in digital commerce.
Retain more earnings with lower transaction fees.
The Components That Make It Work Together

To create a robust digital commerce stack, several components are necessary. You need a hosting solution, such as Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages, to serve your website. For backend logic, tools like Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle the transaction and delivery processes. Supabase or Google Sheets can be used for order storage and management. Finally, integrating NOWPayments ensures that you can accept multiple cryptocurrencies while keeping fees low. When these components are synergized, they create a powerful platform for selling digital products.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To get started, first choose a hosting solution and set up your website. Then, implement backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to manage the payment process. Next, set up your order storage with Supabase or Google Sheets to keep track of sales. Finally, integrate NOWPayments to handle cryptocurrency transactions. With the Complete Builder Kit ($197), you can access all the necessary blueprints and templates to deploy your sovereign digital commerce stack efficiently. This kit is an instant download, providing everything you need to start selling.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, consider using a crypto payment gateway like NOWPayments. This allows you to accept cryptocurrencies directly, simplifying the payment process while significantly reducing fees. With a 0.5% fee compared to PayPal's charges, you can retain more of your earnings and directly reach your audience without restrictions.
Empower your digital business with full ownership and control.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you’re looking to sell digital downloads without platform fees, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) provides all the blueprints and templates necessary. By accessing resources from https://coremerch.github.io/products.html, you can build a sustainable digital store that operates solely on crypto transactions, eliminating reliance on conventional payment methods.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.

Absolutely. By leveraging a sovereign digital commerce stack using Cloudflare Pages and NOWPayments, you can sell templates and fonts directly to customers without the constraints of traditional platforms.
What cryptocurrencies can I accept for my digital products?
With NOWPayments, you can accept over 300 cryptocurrencies, giving your customers flexibility in how they choose to pay. This opens up your market to a broader audience who prefer using crypto.
Is there ongoing support after deployment?

Yes, both the Sovereign Starter Stack and Edge Commerce Stack come with 30-day support post-deployment. This ensures you can troubleshoot and optimize your setup as you begin selling your digital products.
